entities.summary: The Ehsan Mosque is a mosque in Mannheim, in the state of Baden-Württemberg, Germany. It was completed in July 2010 and has a capacity of 450 worshippers. The mosque is administered by the Ahmadiyya Muslim Jamaat Deutschland K.d.ö.R. (AMJ).
